title: Override userDatabaseProvider/coarsePacedTrackIdsProvider/contentIndexProvider in LearningScreen widget tests — real Drift DB is being constructed on every pump
why: Neither _buildScreen() (l1 file) nor buildTestWidget() (plain file) overrides coarsePacedTrackIdsProvider or contentIndexProvider, both of which LearningScreen.build() watches unconditionally. coarsePacedTrackIdsProvider falls through to its real implementation, which calls ref.watch(userDatabaseProvider).goalDao.getGoalsByProfile(...) — constructing a real driftDatabase(name: 'learning_tracker'). I ran `flutter test` on both files directly and reproduced Drift's own warning verbatim: 'It looks like you've created the database class UserDatabase multiple times... race conditions will occur and might corrupt the database' — 22 times across the 23 widget-pumping tests in learning_screen_l1_test.dart and once in learning_screen_test.dart (first pump per process is silent; every subsequent one warns). Every ProviderScope in these tests opens a NEW real UserDatabase instance sharing the same QueryExecutor/file name, i.e. real shared mutable state across nominally-isolated tests — the exact thing TQ-6 forbids. At least 10 other test files in this repo (e.g. test/features/scheduler/presentation/screens/study_day_config_screen_l1_test.dart) correctly override userDatabaseProvider with an in-memory double; these two files, both touching the same HOTSPOT screen, fell out of sync with LearningScreen's provider surface after coarse-track grouping was added.
recommendation: Add userDatabaseProvider (in-memory test double per test/helpers/test_database.dart), coarsePacedTrackIdsProvider, and contentIndexProvider overrides to both _buildScreen and buildTestWidget. Add a CI/audit grep that fails if `flutter test` output for these files contains the literal string 'WARNING (drift)'.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter test test/features/learning/presentation/screens/` produces zero occurrences of 'WARNING (drift)' in stdout/stderr
Both override lists explicitly override userDatabaseProvider, coarsePacedTrackIdsProvider, and contentIndexProvider
New grep-based Rule-0 check (Makefile or CI step) greps flutter test output for 'WARNING (drift)' and fails the build if found

corrections: Minor: empirical run showed 23 'WARNING (drift)' occurrences in learning_screen_l1_test.dart vs the finding's claimed 22 — negligible discrepancy that does not affect the defect's validity.

Drift warning count is 23 in my reproduction (26 tests total, first pump silent), not the claimed 22 — immaterial off-by-one, does not affect the finding's validity. Severity should be P2, not P1, to match two structurally identical sibling findings (grp-065, grp-050) in the same audit rated P2 for the same TQ-6 pattern.
